recovery_branch_review.proposed_future_disposition: No target restore or known release. Original bounded control/drain rights themselves must be explicit valid,not implicit from failure.

recovery_branch_review.proposed_future_disposition: Block further recovery actions; no refill,renewal/new grant or exemption. Retain pending obligations and evidence without unauthorized cleanup.

Irreversible forward stop for failure/expiry/revocation or normal completion; retain all original nonzero/raw statuses and earlier effects.
Authenticated original narrowly scoped recovery whitelist and own live recovery gate; forward loss alone creates no recovery permission.

Original finite durable budget and once-only action identity; spend before action,unknown spend/ACK prevents action/replay,no refill or retry.
Exact stable original writer/object/alias exclusion remained continuous through original capture and current effects; no reacquire or restore foreign drift.
Full original owned descendant/FD/stream/status/effect drain independently known before restoration; parentexit or sent signal not proof.
Known exact original content/metadata/type/presence and source/archive/backup identities with approved deltas; no substitution of changed observed state.
Complete expected original target/config/state/boot/unrelated/source/backend vector and independently verified actual equivalence; owned paths only individual whitelist.
Original target evidence under continuous guard and known children before release; preserve unknown artifacts/obligations and separate future publication rights.
